integrity: Published results on the same quadratic shift family, weak concavity, weighted-shift Hankel tests, and complete reciprocal-rational Hausdorff positivity are credited. Historical novelty is a best-knowledge assessment, not a certification.
scientific_limitations: The complete classification applies to one-variable quadratic-moment positive unilateral shifts, not arbitrary three-isometries or higher finite hyponormality orders. Analytical proof plus standalone finite/symbolic checks; no independent validation.
title: Sharp two-hyponormality boundary for Cauchy duals of quadratic three-isometric shifts
